communication.topologyDescription: Use this section to review who each agent can contact, where it dispatches tasks, and open that agent's settings dialog directly.
communication.noTopology: No communication topology is available yet.
communication.agentSectionDescription: Decide whether this agent participates in collaboration and where it can dispatch tasks.
communication.agentNetworkEnabledHint: This agent is already part of the global communication network.
communication.agentNetworkDisabledHint: Add this agent to the network from the page-level communication card first.

instructions.title: Collaboration Instructions
instructions.description: Preview and sync the ClawX-Cat-managed multi-agent collaboration block into this agent's AGENTS.md.
instructions.hint: ClawX-Cat only updates the managed block and does not overwrite your other AGENTS.md content.

layout.agentListDescription: Select an agent and open its settings dialog to review or edit the full configuration.
layout.selectedAgentHint: Click "View details" to open the current agent settings in a dialog.
layout.emptySelection: Select an agent to view its details.

createDialog.title: Add Agent
createDialog.description: Create a new agent by name. You can optionally inherit the main agent's workspace bootstrap files.
createDialog.inheritWorkspaceDescription: Copy SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, etc. from the main agent

importDialog.title: Import Package
importDialog.description: Choose a packaged ZIP, then name the new agent. Import replaces the new agent workspace and runtime directories.
importDialog.nameHint: Only English letters, digits, and ASCII symbols are supported.
importDialog.invalidName: Only English letters, digits, and ASCII symbols are supported.
importDialog.duplicateName: New agent names must be unique.
importDialog.duplicateSource: Source agent directories and workspace directories cannot be assigned twice.
importDialog.replaceHint: Import fully replaces `workspace-<agentId>` and `agents/<agentId>`, including session files.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Agent
deleteDialog.message: Delete "{{name}}" from ClawX-Cat? This permanently deletes the agent and its ClawX-Cat-managed workspace, runtime, and session files from disk.

settingsDialog.title: {{name}} Settings
settingsDialog.description: Update the agent name and manage which channels belong to this agent.
settingsDialog.modelProviderEmpty: No provider accounts configured. Add one in Settings → AI Providers.
settingsDialog.modelOverrideDescription: Select provider and model ID for this agent.
settingsDialog.unsavedChangesMessage: You have unsaved changes. If you close now, your changes will be discarded.
settingsDialog.channelsDescription: This list is read-only. Manage channel accounts and bindings in the Channels page.
settingsDialog.channelsManagedInChannels: This agent is linked to channel types. Manage exact account bindings in the Channels page.
settingsDialog.noChannels: No channels are assigned to this agent yet.

removeChannelDialog.title: Remove Channel
removeChannelDialog.message: Remove {{name}} from ClawX-Cat? This deletes the current channel configuration.
